item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for FitTrack using both of these attached screenshots, the home screen pic and the workout screen pic? I’m excited to see the app presented as an ad, because I’ve been trying to imagine how it would feel in motion. The look should be clean and energetic, and somewhere in all that it needs to be 10 seconds long in widescreen 16:9. Please show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name, FitTrack. I’d like an upbeat instrumental beat with no voiceover, and any other copy is your call.

dialog.agent:
Here’s the direction I’d use for your **10-second, 16:9 FitTrack ad**:

- **0–3 seconds:** Home screenshot slides into a clean white layout with blue accents. Copy: **“Your day. In motion.”**
- **3–7 seconds:** A quick transition reveals the workout screenshot, with energetic green accents. Copy: **“Make every rep count.”**
- **7–10 seconds:** Finish on **FitTrack** with the tagline **“Track today. Build tomorrow.”**
- **Audio:** Upbeat instrumental beat, with no vocals or voiceover.

**I haven’t generated it yet:** the required account-check tool isn’t available in this connection, so I can’t verify credits and eligibility before starting. I won’t drop either screenshot or shorten your requested duration to work around that.

Also, Magic Hour’s current guidance requires a paid subscription or credit-pack purchase for commercial use.
dialog.why: It says it has not generated the ad because the required account-check tool is unavailable, preventing verification of credits and eligibility.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
The attempt was refused because the account has **insufficient credits**. No video was generated, and there’s no download link.

The request kept your full brief: **10 seconds, 16:9, both screenshots—home first, workout second—ending with FitTrack**, plus upbeat instrumental audio and no voiceover. Adding credits would allow another attempt; accepting free-plan quality alone doesn’t resolve the credit shortage.

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second widescreen 16:9 fitness app advertisement for FitTrack using BOTH supplied screenshot references, in this exact order. Clean, energetic motion graphics, crisp white background, blue and green accents, tasteful soft shadows, smooth kinetic transitions. Preserve screenshot UI text and layout faithfully, display each complete portrait screenshot legibly within the landscape composition without cropping. 0–3 seconds: show @home first, as a large centered app panel with subtle push-in, blue accent lines and the supporting copy 'Your day. In motion.' 3–7 seconds: transition smoothly to @workout, as a large app panel with green accents and the supporting copy 'Make every rep count.' 7–10 seconds: transition away from the UI to a clean end card with the exact app name 'FitTrack' large and centered, smaller tagline 'Track today. Build tomorrow.' Hold the end card clearly through the finish. Keep text sparse and readable, no people, no invented app features. Audio: upbeat modern instrumental electronic beat, bright percussion and warm bass, synchronized to transitions, resolving at the end. Absolutely no voiceover, no speech, no singing or vocals.
